identity.title: OSHA Form 300A: Summary of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses for Year 2025

scan.summary: This is OSHA's Form 300A, the annual summary of work-related injuries and illnesses for the 2025 calendar year, issued by the company and certified by the plant manager on February 1, 2026. The form reports three total recordable cases (one with days away from work, zero with job transfer/restriction, and two other recordable cases), six total days away from work, three injuries, and zero deaths across 65 employees working 128,400 hours. This is a required federal record for any employer with 10 or more employees not in an exempt industry; it must be posted in a conspicuous location from February 1 through April 30, 2026.
scan.freshness_note: This record is current. The form is dated February 1, 2026, and must remain posted until April 30, 2026. As of today (September 29, 2026), the required posting period has ended; the company should retain it for five years per 29 CFR 1904.32(e).

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence in reading the document itself—all data points, figures, and certifying official are clearly stated. The form appears completed correctly with accurate establishment information and injury/illness counts adding up (1 + 0 + 2 = 3 total cases). Moderate confidence regarding completeness: this is a summary form only; it does not show the underlying 300 Log or 301 incident reports, so the accuracy of the summary cannot be verified from this document alone. One area of uncertainty: NAICS code 424690 (chemical merchant wholesaler, repackaging) appears to be in a high-hazard industry category, which would require electronic submission if the establishment has 20–249 employees (this company has 65). The web search confirms that chemical manufacturing is on the high-hazard list for electronic submission thresholds. If this is the case, the company would be required to submit the 300A data to OSHA's Injury Tracking Application by March 2, 2026, which is not addressed in the document itself. This deadline has now passed (today is September 29, 2026), so whether submission occurred cannot be determined from this record alone.
